verdict.rationale: Cursor explicitly documents choosing between models from multiple providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Cursor's own, etc.) and supports bringing your own API keys for OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Azure OpenAI, and AWS Bedrock, giving developers direct control over which model powers their session. Missing for 10: no independent hands-on corroboration of the model-switching UI experience beyond first-party docs.
